nodes.name: .dutchbay_bootstrap_report.json
nodes.summary: Generated bootstrap health-check report listing the resolved repo root, virtualenv, key config files, entry-point scripts, and the Go-With-The-Flow ruleset (51 rules, v3.0) with per-check ok/details status.

nodes.name: .pre-commit-config.yaml
nodes.summary: Pre-commit hook configuration for the Go-With-The-Flow CI gate, wiring black, ruff (--fix), isort (black profile), and the standard pre-commit-hooks set; mypy is intentionally deferred to CI.

nodes.name: Makefile
nodes.summary: Developer task runner defining setup, lint, type, security, test, coverage, package, freeze, lock, and clean targets that wrap pip, black/ruff/flake8, mypy, bandit, coverage, and the project zip/build steps.

nodes.id: document:AAA - instructions for make clean zip.md
nodes.name: AAA - instructions for make clean zip.md
nodes.summary: Short operator note describing the workflow to commit changes, generate a codebase snapshot, and drag the resulting markdown into the Perplexity desktop app for analysis.
nodes.filePath: AAA - instructions for make clean zip.md

nodes.name: CHANGELOG.md
nodes.summary: Versioned change history of the DutchBay model spanning v0.1.6 through v14.15.0, documenting sprint deliverables such as the wind-to-finance integration bridge, CASPER contract alignment, equity distribution, and sensitivity-suite unification.

nodes.name: DEGRADATION_IMPLEMENTATION_STATUS.md
nodes.summary: Status report for the wind-turbine degradation feature, covering its config layer, parameter extraction, production application, verification of no double-counting, and the 20-year revenue impact on AEP.

nodes.name: PYDANTIC_V2_RUNTIME_RISKS.md
nodes.summary: Risk analysis of the Pydantic V2 migration enumerating high-priority runtime hazards (frozen-model mutation, .dict() vs .model_dump(), computed fields) and the defensive adapter/dataclass patterns applied across the contracts layer.

nodes.name: QUICK_START.md
nodes.summary: Concise getting-started guide for the DutchBay model covering venv setup, running the four CLI routines, the Python API, tests, and where key modules live.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Top-level project overview for the 150MW wind-farm financial model describing architecture, core modules, financial-modeling and analytics features, development standards, usage examples, and the roadmap.

nodes.name: RELEASING.md
nodes.summary: Release runbook for v14.15.0 detailing the steps to ensure a clean state, freeze/lock dependencies, bump the version, tag and push, and trigger GitHub Actions.

nodes.name: RETROSPECTIVE_SPRINT9_ITERATION1.md
nodes.summary: Sprint 9 iteration-1 retrospective with a full codebase analysis of the entry point, pipeline, configuration, and each module (wind, finance, analytics, scenarios, schema, tests) plus a GWTF compliance matrix and recommendations.

nodes.name: RETROSPECTIVE_SPRINT9_ITERATION2.md
nodes.summary: Expert Sprint 9 iteration-2 retrospective verifying GWTF/CASPER/CESSPIT/CCCDIR framework compliance and identifying critical domain gaps in wind degradation, dual-DSCR debt sizing, and time-varying availability with an implementation roadmap.

nodes.name: SECURITY.md
nodes.summary: Minimal security policy stating supported versions and how to privately report a vulnerability for the project.

nodes.name: SPRINT_17_ITERATION_3_AUDIT.md
nodes.summary: Comprehensive Sprint 17 codebase audit assessing the pipeline architecture, finance module (degradation, dual-DSCR, tax), Monte-Carlo and sensitivity analytics, framework compliance, production readiness, and a risk register.

nodes.name: SPRINT_9_HANDOVER.md
nodes.summary: Thread-handover document for Sprint 9 summarizing the verified degradation implementation, branch status, outstanding testing/validation items, key decisions, and a quick-start plan for the next working thread.

nodes.name: VERIFY_PACKAGES.sh
nodes.summary: Verification shell script that activates the project virtualenv and runs mypy type checking and pytest across the core packages, reporting colored pass/fail status for each phase.
nodes.languageNotes: Bash script; uses set -e and sources .venv311/bin/activate.

nodes.name: WIND_RESOURCE_IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md
nodes.summary: Phased build plan for the wind-resource module covering the analyzer, energy calculator, and pipeline modules plus Hydra-based CLI tools and config, with a GWTF compliance checklist and progress tracking.

nodes.name: WIND_RESOURCE_STATUS.md
nodes.summary: Completion status report for the wind-resource module confirming all phases done, full GWTF compliance, module/CLI statistics, usage examples, and validated DutchBay results at 150m hub height.

nodes.name: check_venv.sh
nodes.summary: Virtualenv guard script that validates the active Python environment (interpreter path, version, required packages) with logging helpers and a usage banner, fataling out when the venv is misconfigured.
nodes.languageNotes: Bash script; most helper functions (info/ok/warn/err/fatal) are one-line logging wrappers.

nodes.name: print_usage
nodes.summary: Prints the command-line usage banner and supported options for the check_venv.sh environment-verification script.

nodes.name: fix_precommit.sh
nodes.summary: One-off Sprint 9 repair script that runs isort on specific analytics/finance modules and re-checks flake8/ruff to resolve import-ordering pre-commit hook violations.
nodes.languageNotes: Bash script targeting analytics/evaluation_v14.py and finance/cashflow_v14*.py.
